name: @wxyc/album-critic-reviews-etl
description: WXYC weekly pull ETL (BS#1830, album-critic-reviews slice / ADR 0012): download the WXYC/research-data manifest.jsonl.gz release asset, match each CorpusItem to a linked library album via the shared exact resolver, extract a <=300-char attributed snippet with Haiku for new items only, and idempotently UPSERT into album_critic_reviews keyed on (album_id, source_url).
